definitions.short: properly, something disgusting (morally), i.e. (as noun) an abhorrence ; especially idolatry or (concretely) an idol
definitions.full: H8441. toebah תּוֺעֵבָה 117 noun feminine abomination ; — absolute ׳ת Gen 43:32 21 t.; תֹּעֵבָה Jer 44:4 ; construct תּוֺעֲבַת Gen 46:34 +; plural תּוֺעֵבוֺת Ezek 8:6 +; construct תּוֺעֲבוֺת 6:11 +, etc.; suffix תֹּעֲבֹתָיוֺ 2Chr 36:8 , etc.; — 1 ritual sense: a. Israel's sacrifices , ׳ת מִצְרַיִם (genitive object) Exod 8:22 (twice in verse) (E), compare Gen 46:34 (J); ׳ת למצרים 43:32 (J); ׳ת לְ of physical repugnance Psa 88:9 . b. to God and his people: ׳ת of unclean food Deut 14:3 ; worshipper of idols Isa 41:24 , compare Jer 2:7 ; various objectionable acts: ׳ת י ׳לפני Deut 24:4 ; ׳ת ׳י 7:25 ( חֵרֶם , compare 7:26 ), 17:1 ; 18:12 ; 22:5 ; 23:19 ; 27:15 ; offering of children ( עשׂה ) 12:31 , compare Jer 32:35 , also plural 2Kin 16:3 2Chr 28:3 ; Deut 18:9 , 12 ( + witchcraft); idolatrous practices (sometimes with other illegal acts) (כ)ת ׳עשׂה 13:15 ; 17:4 ; Ezek 16:50 ; 18:12 ; Mal 2:11 (intermarriage with idolaters), compare Jer 44:4 ; usually with plural noun Deut 20:18 ; 1Kin 14:24 ; 2Kin 21:2 , 11 ; 2Chr 33:2 ; 36:8 ; Jer 7:10 ; 44:22 ; Ezek 8:6 12 t. Ezekiel; compare תועבות 2Chr 36:14 ; Ezra 9:1 , 11 , 14 ; Ezek 5:9 18t. Ezekiel; of idols Deut 32:16 ; ( תועבה ) 2Kin 23:13 ; Isa 44:19 (compare Deut 27:15 ); idolatrous objects 2Chr 34:33 ; || שׁקּוצים Jer 16:18 (R JE ) Ezek 5:11 ; 11:18 , 21 , ( ת ׳צַלְמֵי ) 7:20 ; || גלולים 14:6 , compare 6:9 ; ת ׳גִּלּוּלֵי 16:36 . 2 ethical sense: a. c. Genitive object of man , ׳ת שְׂפָתַי Prov 8:7 , ׳ת מלכים 16:12 , ׳ת צדיקים 29:27 a, ׳ת כסילים 13:19 , ׳ת רָשָׁע 29:27 b, ׳ת לְאָדָם 24:9 . b. to God and his people: ׳ת of sacrifice of wicked Prov 21:27 (compare 15:8 ), his prayers 28:9 compare Isa 1:13 ( ׳ת לְ ), probably also Jer 6:15 = 8:12 (of various kinds of wickedness); unchastity Lev 18:22 ; with עשׂה 20:13 (H) Ezek 22:11 ; 33:26 ; compare תועבות Lev 18:26-27 , 29 (compare 18:30 ; H), also Prov 26:25 ; ׳ת ׳י Deut 25:16 ; Prov 3:32 10 t. Proverbs, compare 6:16 .
